blocks.zh: 第八章：自我查核
blocks.en: Chapter 8: Self-Inspections

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解自我查核 (self-inspection) 在 GDP 合規中的角色 — 它是一種主動監控機制，而非被動回應稽查
blocks.en: Understand the role of self-inspection in GDP compliance: it is a proactive monitoring mechanism, not a reactive response to inspections

blocks.zh: 掌握自我查核計畫 (self-inspection programme) 的設計要素：涵蓋範圍、時間框架、可分割執行的彈性
blocks.en: Master the design elements of a self-inspection programme: scope of coverage, time frame, and the flexibility to divide the programme into parts

blocks.zh: 了解執行人員的資格要求：公正性 (impartial) 與專業能力 (competent) 缺一不可
blocks.en: Understand the qualification requirements for those performing self-inspections: being impartial and being competent are both essential

blocks.zh: 明確外部專家稽核的補充角色 — 有價值但不能取代自我查核
blocks.en: Clarify the complementary role of external expert audits: valuable, but not a substitute for self-inspection

blocks.zh: 建立完整的記錄、報告與 CAPA 追蹤鏈，從發現問題到驗證改善
blocks.en: Build a complete chain of records, reports and CAPA follow-up, from identifying a finding to verifying the improvement

blocks.zh: 8.1 Principle — 原則
blocks.en: 8.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：自我查核的雙重目的
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual Purpose of Self-Inspection

blocks.zh: 本節精簡地揭示自我查核的兩個功能：
blocks.en: This section concisely sets out two functions of self-inspection:

blocks.zh: Monitor implementation（監控執行情形）： 確認 SOP 是否被實際遵循，而非只是「存在」於文件管理系統中。這是確認「說到做到」的機制。
blocks.en: Monitor implementation: Confirm that SOPs are actually followed, not merely "present" in the document management system. It is the mechanism that verifies the company does what it says.

blocks.zh: Propose necessary corrective measures（提出改善措施）： 自我查核不只是找問題，更是推動改善的引擎。沒有後續 CAPA 的自我查核形同虛設。
blocks.en: Propose necessary corrective measures: Self-inspection is not only about finding problems; it is the engine that drives improvement. A self-inspection without follow-up CAPA is meaningless.

blocks.zh: 自我查核的本質是企業對自己的「預防性稽查」，目的是在監管機關發現問題之前，先行發現並解決。
blocks.en: In essence, self-inspection is a company's own "preventive audit": the aim is to find and resolve problems before the regulatory authority does.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 自我查核就像開車前的「車輛安全自查」。你不會等到車子拋錨了才檢查，而是定期確認煞車、輪胎、燈光、油量等關鍵項目是否正常。GDP 自我查核的邏輯相同 — 與其等監管機關來找問題，不如自己定期把關，確保各項配送管控機制運作正常。發現問題後立即修理（CAPA），才是讓車（企業）安全上路的保障。
blocks.en: Self-inspection is like a "pre-trip vehicle safety check". You do not wait until the car breaks down to check it; you regularly confirm that the brakes, tyres, lights and fuel level are all in order. GDP self-inspection follows the same logic: rather than waiting for the regulator to find problems, you check regularly yourself to make sure each distribution control is working. Fixing problems immediately (CAPA) is what keeps the car (the company) safe on the road.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: 自我查核 vs. 外部稽核的定位： 自我查核（內部執行）是 GDP 的強制要求；外部稽核（客戶稽核、第三方查核）是外部品質保證工具。兩者目的不同：自我查核是你對自己的監督，外部稽核是利益相關方對你的評估。外部稽核有助於「盲點發現」，但 GDP 明確規定外部稽核不能取代內部的自我查核計畫。
blocks.en: Self-inspection vs. external audit: Self-inspection (performed internally) is a mandatory GDP requirement; external audits (customer audits, third-party inspections) are external quality assurance tools. Their purposes differ: self-inspection is your own oversight of yourself, while an external audit is an assessment of you by stakeholders. External audits help uncover "blind spots", but GDP explicitly states that they cannot replace the internal self-inspection programme.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若一家公司每年接受三次客戶稽核，他們是否仍需要執行 GDP 自我查核？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a company undergoes three customer audits a year, does it still need to carry out GDP self-inspections? Why?

blocks.zh: 自我查核找到缺失但沒有採取任何改善行動，在 GDP 查廠中可能造成什麼結果？
blocks.en: If a self-inspection identifies deficiencies but no corrective action is taken, what consequences might this have in a GDP inspection?

blocks.zh: 8.2 Self-Inspections — 自我查核實施
blocks.en: 8.2 Self-Inspections

blocks.zh: 核心概念：自我查核計畫的四個設計要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: Four Design Elements of a Self-Inspection Programme

blocks.zh: 8.2.1 計畫設計：
blocks.en: 8.2.1 Programme design:

blocks.zh: 全面覆蓋 (All aspects of GDP)： 計畫必須覆蓋所有 GDP 章節 — 品質管理、人員、文件、倉儲、運輸、委外活動等
blocks.en: Full coverage (all aspects of GDP): The programme must cover all GDP chapters, including quality management, personnel, documentation, storage, transportation and outsourced activities

blocks.zh: 定義時間框架 (Defined time frame)： 必須明確規定計畫完成的週期（如每年一輪）
blocks.en: Defined time frame: The cycle for completing the programme must be clearly specified (for example, one full round per year)

blocks.zh: 可分割執行 (Divided into limited scope)： 允許按主題或部門分批執行，不需一次完成所有查核。例如第一季查倉儲，第二季查運輸，第三季查文件，第四季查委外活動
blocks.en: Divided into limited scope: The programme may be run in parts by topic or department; it does not all have to be completed at once. For example, storage in Q1, transportation in Q2, documentation in Q3 and outsourced activities in Q4

blocks.zh: 8.2.2 執行者資格： 「公正」代表查核者不應查核自己負責的業務；「稱職」代表對 GDP 要求有充分了解。交叉查核（cross-auditing）是常見的實踐方式。
blocks.en: 8.2.2 Qualifications of those performing self-inspections: "Impartial" means inspectors should not inspect the operations they are responsible for; "competent" means they have a sound understanding of GDP requirements. Cross-auditing is a common practice.

blocks.zh: 8.2.3 完整的記錄與 CAPA 鏈： 所有觀察事項（包含正面與缺失）都必須記錄。管理層必須收到報告副本，確保高層知情與支持改善。CAPA 必須文件化且持續追蹤，不能發現問題後不了了之。
blocks.en: 8.2.3 Complete records and the CAPA chain: All observations (both positive findings and deficiencies) must be recorded. Management must receive a copy of the report, so that senior leadership is informed and supports the improvements. CAPA must be documented and tracked continuously; problems must not simply be dropped once found.

blocks.zh: 自我查核計畫就像一份「年度健康檢查計畫」。你不需要在一天內做完所有檢查，而是分季安排（血液、影像、眼科、牙科各有時段）。「公正」就像找不同的醫生幫你看診，而非自己診斷自己。「管理層收到報告」就像健檢結果除了給你本人，還要給你的家庭醫師存檔。「CAPA 追蹤」就像醫生說你膽固醇偏高後，需要在三個月後回診確認改善情形，而不是只說「我知道了」就算完。
blocks.en: A self-inspection programme is like an "annual health check programme". You do not need to do every test in one day; you schedule them by quarter (blood tests, imaging, eye and dental checks each get their own slot). "Impartial" is like seeing a different doctor rather than diagnosing yourself. "Management receives the report" is like the results going not only to you but also to your family doctor for the file. "CAPA follow-up" is like a doctor telling you your cholesterol is high and asking you to come back in three months to confirm it has improved, rather than just saying "I know" and leaving it there.

blocks.zh: 「All observations」的記錄要求： 8.2.3 要求報告包含「所有的觀察事項」，不只是缺失，也包含優良實踐的確認。這個完整記錄在查廠時很重要 — 稽查員會想看你的自我查核報告，若報告只有「一切良好」而沒有任何缺失發現，反而會引起懷疑（沒有一個系統是完美的）。適度揭露小問題並附上 CAPA，反而展示了有效的自我監控能力。
blocks.en: Recording "all observations": 8.2.3 requires the report to include "all observations", not only deficiencies but also confirmation of good practices. This complete record matters during an inspection: inspectors will want to see your self-inspection reports, and a report that says only "everything is fine" with no deficiencies found will actually raise suspicion (no system is perfect). Appropriately disclosing minor issues together with their CAPA demonstrates effective self-monitoring.

blocks.zh: 外部查核不能取代內部計畫： 即使你的客戶每季都來稽核，GDP 仍要求你有自己的、由公司人員執行的自我查核計畫。外部查核有「外部視角」的優點，但內部自我查核有「深度了解系統」的優勢，兩者互補而非替代。
blocks.en: External audits cannot replace the internal programme: Even if your customers audit you every quarter, GDP still requires you to have your own self-inspection programme performed by company personnel. External audits offer the advantage of an "outside perspective", while internal self-inspection offers "deep knowledge of the system"; the two complement rather than replace each other.

blocks.zh: 你的倉儲主管認為「自我查核」就是他每天巡視倉庫。這符合 GDP 的自我查核要求嗎？差異在哪裡？
blocks.en: Your warehouse supervisor considers "self-inspection" to be his daily walk-through of the warehouse. Does this meet the GDP self-inspection requirement? What is the difference?

blocks.zh: 上次自我查核發現溫度記錄儀有 10% 未按時校正。CAPA 訂了改善計畫，但三個月後的追蹤查核顯示問題仍存在。接下來應採取什麼升級行動？
blocks.en: The last self-inspection found that 10% of temperature data loggers were not calibrated on time. A CAPA plan was set, but a follow-up inspection three months later shows the problem persists. What escalation actions should be taken next?

blocks.zh: 若自我查核報告在後來的 TFDA 查廠中被要求提示，你希望報告呈現什麼格式與內容，能最有效地展示 GDP 合規？
blocks.en: If the self-inspection report is requested during a later TFDA inspection, what format and content would you want it to have in order to demonstrate GDP compliance most effectively?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 要為批發配送業務建立 GDP 自我查核計畫。以下是一個符合 8.2 要求的年度計畫框架：
blocks.en: Your CDMO needs to establish a GDP self-inspection programme for its wholesale distribution business. The following is an annual programme framework that meets the requirements of 8.2:

blocks.zh: 每次查核完成後 10 個工作天內：提交報告給總經理；30 天內：CAPA 計畫核准；90 天內：CAPA 完成並驗證有效性。
blocks.en: Within 10 working days after each inspection: submit the report to the General Manager; within 30 days: CAPA plan approved; within 90 days: CAPA completed and effectiveness verified.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 自我查核的目的： 主動監控 GDP 執行情形並推動改善，是企業對自身運作的預防性稽查機制
blocks.en: Purpose of self-inspection: To proactively monitor GDP implementation and drive improvement; it is the company's preventive audit of its own operations

blocks.zh: 計畫設計三要素： 全面覆蓋 GDP 所有層面 / 定義完成週期（時間框架）/ 可分割成多個有限範圍的查核分批執行
blocks.en: Three elements of programme design: Full coverage of all aspects of GDP / a defined completion cycle (time frame) / division into several limited-scope inspections run in parts

blocks.zh: 執行者資格： 必須由公司內部指定的「公正且稱職」人員執行；交叉查核是確保公正性的實用方法
blocks.en: Qualifications of inspectors: Inspections must be performed by personnel designated within the company who are "impartial and competent"; cross-auditing is a practical way to ensure impartiality

blocks.zh: 外部稽核的角色： 有補充價值，但不能取代內部自我查核計畫
blocks.en: Role of external audits: They add value but cannot replace the internal self-inspection programme

blocks.zh: 記錄與 CAPA 鏈： 所有觀察（含正面）必須記錄 → 報告提交管理層 → 缺失必須有 CAPA → CAPA 必須追蹤驗證
blocks.en: Records and the CAPA chain: All observations (including positive ones) must be recorded → report submitted to management → deficiencies must have CAPA → CAPA must be tracked and verified

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用： 將自我查核計畫設計為季度輪巡各 GDP 主題，指定非直接負責部門人員交叉查核，建立固定的報告與 CAPA 時程
blocks.en: CDMO application: Design the self-inspection programme as a quarterly rotation through the GDP topics, designate personnel from departments not directly responsible to cross-audit, and set fixed timelines for reporting and CAPA
